Reference grids for the schemes in docs/light-schemes.md, printed by linnkit (cmd/linnkit grid, uncommitted work of
2026-09-12) with -cc from the scales in SCL/. Each line below is the command (scale paths shortened) and its output file.

linnkit grid -offset 9 -scheme chain 22edo.scl  >  22edo_chain.txt
linnkit grid -offset 9 -scheme moskeys 22edo.scl  >  22edo_moskeys.txt
linnkit grid -offset 9 -scheme wijmenga 22edo.scl  >  22edo_wijmenga.txt
linnkit grid -offset 9 -scheme kite 22edo.scl  >  22edo_kite.txt
linnkit grid -offset 9 -scheme factors 22edo.scl  >  22edo_factors.txt
linnkit grid -offset 9 -scheme steps 22edo.scl  >  22edo_steps.txt
linnkit grid -offset 9 -scheme nested 22edo.scl  >  22edo_nested.txt
linnkit grid -offset 9 -scheme consonance 22edo.scl  >  22edo_consonance.txt
linnkit grid -offset 9 -scheme harmonics 22edo.scl  >  22edo_harmonics.txt
